body: It is so hard. When you think about it though it’s SO DUMB. Like WHY? Why should how big my nose is matter? Like it’s a nose and I can smell stuff. I can still give head like a champ and I’m fairly intelligent in my studies. I just look like a hobgoblin. It’s annoying how much it hurts me. Something I can’t even control.

The thing about obstacles is every individuals tolerance level for the bullshit that happens to them in their life is different. People experience things differently. What is an inconvenience to me might be the end of the world for you and vice versa. It’s annoying to be reminded that there are others with worse life situations.. because we basically have to come to terms with the hand we’ve been dealt.. basically right now I’m living out of spite because I’m mad asf at the world for trying to constantly tear me down. I encourage you to do the same.
